subject: phase3_requests_cumulative_context_retest
statement: Run one bounded Requests historical-control retest to measure the accepted cumulative-context and tool-call policy before selecting a new SWE-EVO instance.
selected_option: run one serial repetition of single_codex, agentteam_direct, and agentteam_full with a 1000000-token per-mode ceiling and 3000000-token aggregate ceiling

alternatives.option: select a new SWE-EVO instance immediately
alternatives.rejected_reason: Changing the task would confound the first measurement of the cumulative-context policy against retained Requests results.

alternatives.option: run only the previously failing agentteam_direct mode
alternatives.rejected_reason: A same-epoch single-agent reference is needed to interpret model-service and task-specific cost variation.

alternatives.option: remove the aggregate ceiling because the tool-call boundary is deterministic
alternatives.rejected_reason: Tool count limits execution rounds but does not prove a fixed provider-token cost for each admitted round.

rationale: The retained Requests runs hold source, task, model profile, public verification, and official evaluator constant. The replacement release adds active-context compaction at 32768 tokens and an atomic 12-call warning and 16-call hard boundary. Repeating the same three-mode order provides the narrowest available engineering estimate of the new mechanism. The experiment remains a historical-control retest rather than a randomized causal benchmark.
expected_outcome: Measure provider-reported token cost, tool-call count, official quality, and wall time for the accepted policy, then decide whether evidence supports moving to a new instance.
acceptance_refs: all provider positions bind the complete six-field context policy
provider usage coverage is 100 percent for every launched invocation
tool execution does not exceed 16 reservations per provider turn
candidate patch compatibility and official evaluator evidence are retained
stop before the next mode when aggregate usage reaches 3000000 tokens
no corrective operator intervention occurs inside a mode execution
